description: Organize long-running work in named terminal windows. Inspect configured windows and start, stop or restart them together or separately. Start with list; each window runs its configured command in one tmux session.
author: Serg Parf

start.help: Open configured windows that are missing, after checking live panes. A name already present reports already running.

stop.help: Stop selected configured windows. Send SIGTERM to their process groups, allow ten seconds to save work, then close them.

restart.help: Stop selected configured windows, then start them with the same live-pane checks.

list.help: See which configured windows exist and have live panes, with process ID, uptime and working directory. Extra windows are marked unmanaged.

status.help: Check whether configured windows are alive. Report ok when all are alive, degraded when some are alive, and failed when none are alive or the session is absent.

help.help: Find available calls and configuration. Every caller admitted by the record may use every method; there are no additional role or Owner checks.

session.help: One tmux session name: 1..32 letters, digits, - or _. Default: instance component of this agent name, or tmux-sessions for the main record.

state_home.help: XDG_STATE_HOME for every window (an existing absolute directory); a window's env overrides it. Default: /var/lib/agent-bus-tmux-sessions[-<instance>] when that is a directory owned by the person (the old standalone unit's state), else inherited.

windows.help: Up to32 objects: required name (unique tmux window name,1..32 letters/digits/-/_), cwd (existing absolute directory), command (non-empty /bin/sh -c string,max4096 bytes,no NUL/newline), optional env (object or the shared env-file text). Base env is stripped; person’s manager PATH is applied, then env overrides it. At most64 env keys,max4096 bytes/value; AGENT_BUS_TOKEN and AB_ROLE_* are refused. Only Owner/Maintainers write Configuration. No runtime, args, tags, window or bus-name keys.
Optional configured window names; none means all configured windows. Unknown names fail before any action.
